selection: Targeted request-text sample selected to exercise explicit entity cues; one example per duplicate group. Not a prevalence-representative random sample.
limitations: AI-assisted candidate annotations require human correction/approval. Do not call these gold labels until the project owner completes review. The sample has weak or zero coverage for rare types such as process_name/process_metric and only one explicit port example; add separate challenge examples if those metrics matter.
offset_contract: Zero-based Python string offsets with exclusive end, into the original request after outer whitespace trimming; entity value must equal request[start:end].
normalization: Retain exact source value; normalized_value is additional metadata only.
overlap_policy: Overlapping spans of different entity types are allowed, e.g. a suffix inside a filename/path.
human_review_policy: Only the human-confirmed_entities_json field in the separate worksheet may be exported as gold. The suggestion JSONL must not be used as gold or for rule tuning until reviewed.
